verses.ar: كٓهٰيٰعٓصٓ
verses.en: Kaf. Ha. Ya. 'Ain. Sad

verses.ar: ذِكۡرُ رَحۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبۡدَهٗ زَكَرِيَّاۖۚ‏
verses.en: (This is) a recital of the Mercy of thy Lord to His servant Zakariya

verses.ar: اِذۡ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا
verses.en: Behold! he cried to his Lord in secret

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ وَهَنَ الۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّيۡ وَاشۡتَعَلَ الرَّاۡسُ شَيۡبًا وَّلَمۡ اَكُنۭۡ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
verses.en: Praying: "O my Lord! infirm indeed are my bones, and the hair of my head doth glisten with grey: but never am I unblest, O my Lord, in my prayer to Thee

verses.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ خِفۡتُ الۡمَوَالِيَ مِنۡ وَّرَآءِيۡ وَكَانَتِ امۡرَاَتِيۡ عَاقِرًا فَهَبۡ لِيۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡكَ وَلِيًّاۙ‏
verses.en: Now I fear (what) my relatives (and colleagues) (will do) after me: but my wife is barren: so give me an heir as from Thyself

verses.ar: يَّرِثُنِيۡ وَيَرِثُ مِنۡ اٰلِ يَعۡقُوۡبَࣗ وَاجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
verses.en: (One that) will (truly) represent me, and represent the posterity of Jacob; and make him, O my Lord! one with whom Thou art well-pleased

verses.ar: يٰزَكَرِيَّا٘ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمِ اِۨسۡمُهٗ يَحۡيٰيۙ لَمۡ نَجۡعَلۡ لَّهٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ سَمِيًّا
verses.en: (His prayer was answered): "O Zakariya! We give thee good news of a son: His name shall be Yahya: on none by that name have We conferred distinction before

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنّٰي يَكُوۡنُ لِيۡ غُلٰمٌ وَّكَانَتِ امۡرَاَتِيۡ عَاقِرًا وَّقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ الۡكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
verses.en: He said: "O my Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren and I have grown quite decrepit from old age

verses.ar: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَۚ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَّقَدۡ خَلَقۡتُكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ تَكُ شَيۡـًٔا
verses.en: He said: "So (it will be) thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: I did indeed create thee before, when thou hadst been nothing

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ٘ اٰيَةًؕ قَالَ اٰيَتُكَ اَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
verses.en: (Zakariya) said: "O my Lord! give me a Sign." "Thy Sign," was the answer, "Shall be that thou shalt speak to no man for three nights, although thou art not dumb

verses.ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ مِنَ الۡمِحۡرَابِ فَاَوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيۡهِمۡ اَنۡ سَبِّحُوۡا بُكۡرَةً وَّعَشِيًّا
verses.en: So Zakariya came out to his people from him chamber: He told them by signs to celebrate Allah's praises in the morning and in the evening

verses.ar: يٰيَحۡيٰي خُذِ الۡكِتٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍؕ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ الۡحُكۡمَ صَبِيًّاۙ‏
verses.en: (To his son came the command): "O Yahya! take hold of the Book with might": and We gave him Wisdom even as a youth

verses.ar: وَّحَنَانًا مِّنۡ لَّدُنَّا وَزَكٰوةًؕ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّاۙ‏
verses.en: And piety (for all creatures) as from Us, and purity: He was devout

verses.ar: وَّبَرًّاۭ بِوَالِدَيۡهِ وَلَمۡ يَكُنۡ جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
verses.en: And kind to his parents, and he was not overbearing or rebellious

verses.ar: وَسَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡهِ يَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوۡمَ يَمُوۡتُ وَيَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُ حَيًّاࣖ‏
verses.en: So Peace on him the day he was born, the day that he dies, and the day that he will be raised up to life (again)

verses.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ مَرۡيَمَۘ اِذِ انۡتَبَذَتۡ مِنۡ اَهۡلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرۡقِيًّاۙ‏
verses.en: Relate in the Book (the story of) Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place in the East

verses.ar: فَاتَّخَذَتۡ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمۡ حِجَابًاࣞ فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهَا رُوۡحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
verses.en: She placed a screen (to screen herself) from them; then We sent her our angel, and he appeared before her as a man in all respects

verses.ar: قَالَتۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعُوۡذُ بِالرَّحۡمٰنِ مِنۡكَ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ تَقِيًّا
verses.en: She said: "I seek refuge from thee to (Allah) Most Gracious: (come not near) if thou dost fear Allah

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّكِࣗۖ لِاَهَبَ لَكِ غُلٰمًا زَكِيًّا
verses.en: He said: "Nay, I am only a messenger from thy Lord, (to announce) to thee the gift of a holy son

verses.ar: قَالَتۡ اَنّٰي يَكُوۡنُ لِيۡ غُلٰمٌ وَّلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِيۡ بَشَرٌ وَّلَمۡ اَكُ بَغِيًّا
verses.en: She said: "How shall I have a son, seeing that no man has touched me, and I am not unchaste

verses.ar: قَالَ كَذٰلِكِۚ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌۚ وَلِنَجۡعَلَهٗ٘ اٰيَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحۡمَةً مِّنَّاۚ وَكَانَ اَمۡرًا مَّقۡضِيًّا
verses.en: He said: "So (it will be): Thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: and (We wish) to appoint him as a Sign unto men and a Mercy from Us': It is a matter (so) decreed

verses.ar: فَحَمَلَتۡهُ فَانۡتَبَذَتۡ بِهٖ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
verses.en: So she conceived him, and she retired with him to a remote place

verses.ar: فَاَجَآءَهَا الۡمَخَاضُ اِلٰي جِذۡعِ النَّخۡلَةِۚ قَالَتۡ يٰلَيۡتَنِيۡ مِتُّ قَبۡلَ هٰذَا وَكُنۡتُ نَسۡيًا مَّنۡسِيًّا
verses.en: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree: She cried (in her anguish): "Ah! would that I had died before this! would that I had been a thing forgotten and out of sight

verses.ar: فَنَادٰىهَا مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا٘ اَلَّا تَحۡزَنِيۡ قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحۡتَكِ سَرِيًّا
verses.en: But (a voice) cried to her from beneath the (palm-tree): "Grieve not! for thy Lord hath provided a rivulet beneath thee

verses.ar: وَهُزِّيۡ٘ اِلَيۡكِ بِجِذۡعِ النَّخۡلَةِ تُسٰقِطۡ عَلَيۡكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّاؗ‏
verses.en: And shake towards thyself the trunk of the palm-tree: It will let fall fresh ripe dates upon thee

verses.ar: فَكُلِيۡ وَاشۡرَبِيۡ وَقَرِّيۡ عَيۡنًاۚ فَاِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الۡبَشَرِ اَحَدًاۙ فَقُوۡلِيۡ٘ اِنِّيۡ نَذَرۡتُ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ صَوۡمًا فَلَنۡ اُكَلِّمَ الۡيَوۡمَ اِنۡسِيًّاۚ‏
verses.en: So eat and drink and cool (thine) eye. And if thou dost see any man, say, 'I have vowed a fast to (Allah) Most Gracious, and this day will I enter into not talk with any human being

verses.ar: فَاَتَتۡ بِهٖ قَوۡمَهَا تَحۡمِلُهٗؕ قَالُوۡا يٰمَرۡيَمُ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتِ شَيۡـًٔا فَرِيًّا
verses.en: At length she brought the (babe) to her people, carrying him (in her arms). They said: "O Mary! truly an amazing thing hast thou brought

verses.ar: يٰ٘اُخۡتَ هٰرُوۡنَ مَا كَانَ اَبُوۡكِ امۡرَاَ سَوۡءٍ وَّمَا كَانَتۡ اُمُّكِ بَغِيًّاۚۖ‏
verses.en: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a man of evil, nor thy mother a woman unchaste

verses.ar: فَاَشَارَتۡ اِلَيۡهِؕࣞ قَالُوۡا كَيۡفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنۡ كَانَ فِي الۡمَهۡدِ صَبِيًّا
verses.en: But she pointed to the babe. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنِّيۡ عَبۡدُ اللّٰهِؕࣞ اٰتٰىنِيَ الۡكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِيۡ نَبِيًّاۙ‏
verses.en: He said: "I am indeed a servant of Allah: He hath given me revelation and made me a prophet

verses.ar: وَّجَعَلَنِيۡ مُبٰرَكًا اَيۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُࣕ وَاَوۡصٰنِيۡ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَالزَّكٰوةِ مَا دُمۡتُ حَيًّاۙ‏
verses.en: And He hath made me blessed wheresoever I be, and hath enjoined on me Prayer and Charity as long as I live

verses.ar: وَّبَرًّاۭ بِوَالِدَتِيۡؗ وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡنِيۡ جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
verses.en: (He) hath made me kind to my mother, and not overbearing or miserable

verses.ar: وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلَيَّ يَوۡمَ وُلِدۡتُّ وَيَوۡمَ اَمُوۡتُ وَيَوۡمَ اُبۡعَثُ حَيًّا
verses.en: So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ عِيۡسَي ابۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۚ قَوۡلَ الۡحَقِّ الَّذِيۡ فِيۡهِ يَمۡتَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Such (was) Jesus the son of Mary: (it is) a statement of truth, about which they (vainly) dispute

verses.ar: مَا كَانَ لِلّٰهِ اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذَ مِنۡ وَّلَدٍۙ سُبۡحٰنَهٗؕ اِذَا قَضٰ٘ي اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُؕ‏
verses.en: It is not befitting to (the majesty of) Allah that He should beget a son. Glory be to Him! when He determines a matter, He only says to it, "Be", and it is

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَبِّيۡ وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡهُؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
verses.en: Verily Allah is my Lord and your Lord: Him therefore serve ye: this is a Way that is straight

verses.ar: فَاخۡتَلَفَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِهِمۡۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ مَّشۡهَدِ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
verses.en: But the sects differ among themselves: and woe to the unbelievers because of the (coming) Judgment of a Momentous Day

verses.ar: اَسۡمِعۡ بِهِمۡ وَاَبۡصِرۡۙ يَوۡمَ يَاۡتُوۡنَنَا لٰكِنِ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ الۡيَوۡمَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: How plainly will they see and hear, the Day that they will appear before Us! but the unjust today are in error manifest

verses.ar: وَاَنۡذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡحَسۡرَةِ اِذۡ قُضِيَ الۡاَمۡرُۘ وَهُمۡ فِيۡ غَفۡلَةٍ وَّهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: But warn them of the Day of Distress, when the matter will be determined: for (behold,) they are negligent and they do not believe

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَرِثُ الۡاَرۡضَ وَمَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا وَاِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: It is We Who will inherit the earth, and all beings thereon: to Us will they all be returned

verses.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ ࣢ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صِدِّيۡقًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.en: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Abraham: He was a man of Truth, a prophet

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ يٰ٘اَبَتِ لِمَ تَعۡبُدُ مَا لَا يَسۡمَعُ وَلَا يُبۡصِرُ وَلَا يُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡكَ شَيۡـًٔا
verses.en: Behold, he said to his father: "O my father! why worship that which heareth not and seeth not, and can profit thee nothing

verses.ar: يٰ٘اَبَتِ اِنِّيۡ قَدۡ جَآءَنِيۡ مِنَ الۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَمۡ يَاۡتِكَ فَاتَّبِعۡنِيۡ٘ اَهۡدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا
verses.en: O my father! to me hath come knowledge which hath not reached thee: so follow me: I will guide thee to a way that is even and straight

verses.ar: يٰ٘اَبَتِ لَا تَعۡبُدِ الشَّيۡطٰنَؕ اِنَّ الشَّيۡطٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ عَصِيًّا
verses.en: O my father! serve not Satan: for Satan is a rebel against (Allah) Most Gracious

verses.ar: يٰ٘اَبَتِ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ فَتَكُوۡنَ لِلشَّيۡطٰنِ وَلِيًّا
verses.en: O my father! I fear lest a Penalty afflict thee from (Allah) Most Gracious, so that thou become to Satan a friend

verses.ar: قَالَ اَرَاغِبٌ اَنۡتَ عَنۡ اٰلِهَتِيۡ يٰ٘اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُۚ لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ لَاَرۡجُمَنَّكَ وَاهۡجُرۡنِيۡ مَلِيًّا
verses.en: (The father) replied: "Dost thou hate my gods, O Abraham? If thou forbear not, I will indeed stone thee: Now get away from me for a good long while

verses.ar: قَالَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡكَۚ سَاَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيۡؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِيۡ حَفِيًّا
verses.en: Abraham said: "Peace be on thee: I will pray to my Lord for thy forgiveness: for He is to me Most Gracious

verses.ar: وَاَعۡتَزِلُكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَاَدۡعُوۡا رَبِّيۡؗۖ عَسٰ٘ي اَلَّا٘ اَكُوۡنَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّيۡ شَقِيًّا
verses.en: And I will turn away from you (all) and from those whom ye invoke besides Allah: I will call on my Lord: perhaps, by my prayer to my Lord, I shall be not unblest

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا اعۡتَزَلَهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِۙ وَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ٘ اِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَؕ وَكُلًّا جَعَلۡنَا نَبِيًّا
verses.en: When he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each one of them We made a prophet

verses.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِيًّاࣖ‏
verses.en: And We bestowed of Our Mercy on them, and We granted them lofty honour on the tongue of truth

verses.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ مُوۡسٰ٘يؗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مُخۡلَصًا وَّكَانَ رَسُوۡلًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.en: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Moses: for he was specially chosen, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet

verses.ar: وَنَادَيۡنٰهُ مِنۡ جَانِبِ الطُّوۡرِ الۡاَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنٰهُ نَجِيًّا
verses.en: And we called him from the right side of Mount (Sinai), and made him draw near to Us, for mystic (converse)

verses.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ مِنۡ رَّحۡمَتِنَا٘ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوۡنَ نَبِيًّا
verses.en: And, out of Our Mercy, We gave him his brother Aaron, (also) a prophet

verses.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ اِسۡمٰعِيۡلَؗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صَادِقَ الۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُوۡلًا نَّبِيًّاۚ‏
verses.en: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Isma'il: He was (strictly) true to what he promised, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet

verses.ar: وَكَانَ يَاۡمُرُ اَهۡلَهٗ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَالزَّكٰوةِࣕ وَكَانَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهٖ مَرۡضِيًّا
verses.en: He used to enjoin on his people Prayer and Charity, and he was most acceptable in the sight of his Lord

verses.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ اِدۡرِيۡسَؗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صِدِّيۡقًا نَّبِيًّاࣗۙ‏
verses.en: Also mention in the Book the case of Idris: He was a man of truth (and sincerity), (and) a prophet

verses.ar: وَّرَفَعۡنٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
verses.en: And We raised him to a lofty station

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَنۡعَمَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنَ النَّبِيّٖنَ مِنۡ ذُرِّيَّةِ اٰدَمَࣗ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوۡحٍؗ وَّمِنۡ ذُرِّيَّةِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؗ وَمِمَّنۡ هَدَيۡنَا وَاجۡتَبَيۡنَاؕ اِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ خَرُّوۡا سُجَّدًا وَّبُكِيًّاࣛ‏
verses.en: Those were some of the prophets on whom Allah did bestow His Grace,- of the posterity of Adam, and of those who We carried (in the Ark) with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel of those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the Signs of (Allah) Most Gracious were rehearsed to them, they would fall down in prostrate adoration and in tears

verses.ar: فَخَلَفَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ اَضَاعُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوٰتِ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّاۙ‏
verses.en: But after them there followed a posterity who missed prayers and followed after lusts soon, then, will they face Destruction

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَاُولٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ الۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ شَيۡـًٔاۙ‏
verses.en: Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness: for these will enter the Garden and will not be wronged in the least

verses.ar: جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنِ اِۨلَّتِيۡ وَعَدَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ عِبَادَهٗ بِالۡغَيۡبِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ وَعۡدُهٗ مَاۡتِيًّا
verses.en: Gardens of Eternity, those which (Allah) Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the Unseen: for His promise must (necessarily) come to pass

verses.ar: لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا لَغۡوًا اِلَّا سَلٰمًاؕ وَلَهُمۡ رِزۡقُهُمۡ فِيۡهَا بُكۡرَةً وَّعَشِيًّا
verses.en: They will not there hear any vain discourse, but only salutations of Peace: And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and evening

verses.ar: تِلۡكَ الۡجَنَّةُ الَّتِيۡ نُوۡرِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَنۡ كَانَ تَقِيًّا
verses.en: Such is the Garden which We give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who guard against Evil

verses.ar: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ اِلَّا بِاَمۡرِ رَبِّكَۚ لَهٗ مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡنَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّاۚ‏
verses.en: (The angels say:) "We descend not but by command of thy Lord: to Him belongeth what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between: and thy Lord never doth forget

verses.ar: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَاعۡبُدۡهُ وَاصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَادَتِهٖؕ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهٗ سَمِيًّاࣖ‏
verses.en: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and of all that is between them; so worship Him, and be constant and patient in His worship: knowest thou of any who is worthy of the same Name as He

verses.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ ءَاِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ اُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا
verses.en: Man says: "What! When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive

verses.ar: اَوَلَا يَذۡكُرُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ يَكُ شَيۡـًٔا
verses.en: But does not man call to mind that We created him before out of nothing

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَالشَّيٰطِيۡنَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّاۚ‏
verses.en: So, by thy Lord, without doubt, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Evil Ones (with them); then shall We bring them forth on their knees round about Hell

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَنۡزِعَنَّ مِنۡ كُلِّ شِيۡعَةٍ اَيُّهُمۡ اَشَدُّ عَلَي الرَّحۡمٰنِ عِتِيًّاۚ‏
verses.en: Then shall We certainly drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against (Allah) Most Gracious

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ اَوۡلٰي بِهَا صِلِيًّا
verses.en: And certainly We know best those who are most worthy of being burned therein

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ مِّنۡكُمۡ اِلَّا وَارِدُهَاۚ كَانَ عَلٰي رَبِّكَ حَتۡمًا مَّقۡضِيًّاۚ‏
verses.en: Not one of you but will pass over it: this is, with thy Lord, a Decree which must be accomplished

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا وَّنَذَرُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا جِثِيًّا
verses.en: But We shall save those who guarded against evil, and We shall leave the wrong-doers therein, (humbled) to their knees

verses.ar: وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘اۙ اَيُّ الۡفَرِيۡقَيۡنِ خَيۡرٌ مَّقَامًا وَّاَحۡسَنُ نَدِيًّا
verses.en: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say to those who believe, "Which of the two sides is best in point of position? Which makes the best show in council

verses.ar: وَكَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ اَثَاثًا وَّرِئۡيًا
verses.en: But how many (countless) generations before them have we destroyed, who were even better in equipment and in glitter to the eye

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ كَانَ فِي الضَّلٰلَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ لَهُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مَدًّا ࣢ۚ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا رَاَوۡا مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ اِمَّا الۡعَذَابَ وَاِمَّا السَّاعَةَ ࣢ؕ فَسَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّاَضۡعَفُ جُنۡدًا
verses.en: Say: "If any men go astray, (Allah) Most Gracious extends (the rope) to them, until, when they see the warning of Allah (being fulfilled) - either in punishment or in (the approach of) the Hour,- they will at length realise who is worst in position, and (who) weakest in forces

verses.ar: وَيَزِيۡدُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اهۡتَدَوۡا هُدًيؕ وَالۡبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيۡرٌ مَّرَدًّا
verses.en: And Allah doth advance in guidance those who seek guidance: and the things that endure, Good Deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best in respect of (their) eventual return

verses.ar: اَفَرَءَيۡتَ الَّذِيۡ كَفَرَ بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَاُوۡتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَّوَلَدًاؕ‏
verses.en: Hast thou then seen the (sort of) man who rejects Our Signs, yet says: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children

verses.ar: اَطَّلَعَ الۡغَيۡبَ اَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنۡدَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَهۡدًاۙ‏
verses.en: Has he penetrated to the Unseen, or has he taken a contract with (Allah) Most Gracious

verses.ar: كَلَّاؕ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا يَقُوۡلُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهٗ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ مَدًّاۙ‏
verses.en: Nay! We shall record what he says, and We shall add and add to his punishment

verses.ar: وَّنَرِثُهٗ مَا يَقُوۡلُ وَيَاۡتِيۡنَا فَرۡدًا
verses.en: To Us shall return all that he talks of and he shall appear before Us bare and alone

verses.ar: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لِّيَكُوۡنُوۡا لَهُمۡ عِزًّاۙ‏
verses.en: And they have taken (for worship) gods other than Allah, to give them power and glory

verses.ar: كَلَّاؕ سَيَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُوۡنُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّاࣖ‏
verses.en: Instead, they shall reject their worship, and become adversaries against them

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا الشَّيٰطِيۡنَ عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ اَزًّاۙ‏
verses.en: Seest thou not that We have set the Evil Ones on against the unbelievers, to incite them with fury

verses.ar: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡؕ اِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمۡ عَدًّاۚ‏
verses.en: So make no haste against them, for We but count out to them a (limited) number (of days)

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ اِلَي الرَّحۡمٰنِ وَفۡدًاۙ‏
verses.en: The day We shall gather the righteous to (Allah) Most Gracious, like a band presented before a king for honours

verses.ar: وَّنَسُوۡقُ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ اِلٰي جَهَنَّمَ وِرۡدًاۘ‏
verses.en: And We shall drive the sinners to Hell, like thirsty cattle driven down to water

verses.ar: لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنۡدَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَهۡدًاۘ‏
verses.en: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from (Allah) Most Gracious

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَلَدًاؕ‏
verses.en: They say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten a son

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا اِدًّاۙ‏
verses.en: Indeed ye have put forth a thing most monstrous

verses.ar: تَكَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنۡشَقُّ الۡاَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ الۡجِبَالُ هَدًّاۙ‏
verses.en: At it the skies are ready to burst, the earth to split asunder, and the mountains to fall down in utter ruin

verses.ar: اَنۡ دَعَوۡا لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ وَلَدًاۚ‏
verses.en: That they should invoke a son for (Allah) Most Gracious

verses.ar: وَمَا يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذَ وَلَدًاؕ‏
verses.en: For it is not consonant with the majesty of (Allah) Most Gracious that He should beget a son

verses.ar: اِنۡ كُلُّ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا٘ اٰتِي الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَبۡدًاؕ‏
verses.en: Not one of the beings in the heavens and the earth but must come to (Allah) Most Gracious as a servant

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ اَحۡصٰىهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدًّاؕ‏
verses.en: He does take an account of them (all), and hath numbered them (all) exactly

verses.ar: وَكُلُّهُمۡ اٰتِيۡهِ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فَرۡدًا
verses.en: And everyone of them will come to Him singly on the Day of Judgment

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وُدًّا
verses.en: On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love

verses.ar: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ وَتُنۡذِرَ بِهٖ قَوۡمًا لُّدًّا
verses.en: So have We made the (Qur'an) easy in thine own tongue, that with it thou mayest give Glad Tidings to the righteous, and warnings to people given to contention

verses.ar: وَكَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍؕ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ اَحَدٍ اَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزًاࣖ‏
verses.en: But how many (countless) generations before them have We destroyed? Canst thou find a single one of them (now) or hear (so much as) a whisper of them
